title: Migrate OpenAI App
excerpt: Migrating from OpenAI Apps SDK to MCP Apps SDK This reference maps OpenAI Apps SDK concepts to their MCP Apps SDK (@modelcontextprotocol/ext apps) equivalents. Use the tables below for quick lookup during migration, and refer to the code examples for complete before/after comparisons. This guide covers server side changes first (metadata, tools, resources), then client side changes (setup, context, events). [!NOTE] Some OpenAI Apps SDK features don't have MCP equivalents yet. These are marked "Not yet implemented" ...
